WITH members_by_major AS (
  SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count
  FROM member
  WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY link_to_major
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(member_count) as total_count, 
    COUNT(*) as num_groups,
    CAST(1 AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as avg_share
  FROM members_by_major
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    m.link_to_major,
    m.member_count,
    CAST(m.member_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share,
    t.avg_share
  FROM members_by_major m, totals t
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT share, member_count, avg_share
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE share > avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(member_count) as total_members_above_avg,
  AVG(share) as avg_share_of_above_avg_groups,
  AVG(share - avg_share) as avg_excess_share
FROM above_average
